name: @yan-zhi/desktop
description: 言智 Electron 桌面端（含内置后端运行时，electron-builder 打包）

scripts.electron:build: pnpm --filter @yan-zhi/server build && vite build && node ./scripts/prepare-server-runtime.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.full.yml --publish never
scripts.electron:build:full: pnpm --filter @yan-zhi/server build && vite build && node ./scripts/prepare-server-runtime.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.full.yml --publish never
scripts.electron:build:lite: pnpm --filter @yan-zhi/server build && vite build && node ./scripts/prepare-server-runtime.cjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.lite.yml --publish never
